rows.jyutping: tung4 ngaa4 ci2 jau5 gwaan1 ge3
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for things concerning teeth, such as dental care or dental pain.

example.english: I really can't stand dental pain.
example.traditional: 同牙齒有關嘅牙痛我真係頂唔順。
example.jyutping: tung4 ngaa4 ci2 jau5 gwaan1 ge3 ngaa4 tung3 ngo5 zan1 hai6 ding2 m4 seon6

rows.jyutping: tung4 ngaa4 fo1 jau5 gwaan1 ge3
rows.note: Use this when dental refers specifically to dentistry as a field, service, or profession rather than to teeth themselves.

example.english: Dental services usually require an appointment.
example.traditional: 同牙科有關嘅服務通常要預約。
example.jyutping: tung4 ngaa4 fo1 jau5 gwaan1 ge3 fuk6 mou6 tung1 soeng4 jiu3 jyu6 joek3
